newsitem.title: USA: Winston-Salem, N.C., proposes $242.9 mln budget.
newsitem.headline: Winston-Salem, N.C., proposes $242.9 mln budget.

text.p: Winston-Salem, N.C. City Manager Bill Stuart has proposed a $242.9 million budget for fiscal 1998, the Journal reported Tuesday.
The proposal would cut the ad valorem tax rate by 6.5 cents, or 11 percent, to 52.5 cents per $100 of assessed value.
The cut would partly offset increases in property value, which averaged 17 percent last year, the newspaper said.
The plan would also close a recyling center, reduce the city workforce by nine jobs, and reduce curbside pickup of bulky trash.
